I will. My sheet has groceries and gas already higher than I wanted, so leftovers would actually help.
That reel with the lantern street and the little wooden bridge made me think of you. Are you still keeping that separate bucket in your banking app?
are you doing the aarti tomorrow morning or just rolling in for colors
colors only lol mom gave up on me for the morning stuff years ago

same. I'll see you around 10:30. my mom is bringing prasad over to your parents' after

save me thandai please, I never make it in time for the food round

Saw your missed call. Everything okay after the partner meeting?

It is work stuff plus Amma asking whether I am bringing anyone to the April thing. Same combo as usual.
Are you stopping at Mom and Dad's Sunday or am I the only one getting recruited for the printer again?
I'll be there after 12. Bring the tiny screwdriver kit from your place if you can.
Fine, but only because I have to drive past the mall anyway. If Dad saved another Comcast notice from 2011, you're reading it.

halfway. school board candidates first, then the supervisor races. who do you have for treasurer?

Forward it to me, but I am going to look for the actual page from Chester County or Penn before deciding anything.

I will. It should still be light, and there will be people near the courthouse.
Can you look at the blue link from Chester County Orthopedics? It says I need to fill the pain scale before Friday.
Yes, send me the code. I also need to log into mine tonight to confirm Dr. Kaur's forms for Tuesday.
I will send. Your father also got one paper from Quest, he says numbers and amount are confusing.
Bring both on Sunday. I will check the Quest charge and set your portal password to something you can remember.
did you see the league of women voters guide dropped for the may primary
yeah i pulled it up at lunch. the prothonotary race is wild this year
wait who are you leaning for school board. the incumbents websites are all so vague
still reading. ballotpedia has decent links to their actual filings. ill send you what i find

October planning already?? Aunty's going to ask what we're wearing the second we walk in lol
I know. I'd rather save the room in the budget for the festival lehenga + the gift pile for the cousins. The blazer I keep meaning to replace can wait another season.

ugh same energy as when I got stopped on Boot Rd last summer. mine was a busted plate light. five minutes, sent me on my way, but I sat in the car shaking after
right?? like nothing happened and we both still react like that. tells you something
yeah. ours is a nothing-burger every time and we still brace. imagine if the baseline wasn't nothing
Spring Valley trail tomorrow? 7am parking lot, full 6 mile loop if your legs are up for it.
Yes please. I've been at the desk all week, I need it.
Good. And after we can grab brunch at Spence, they have that lavender latte you liked.
Sold. I'll bring the extra water bottles.
For Sunday, come a little before 11 if you can. I soaked the chana already.
I can. I’ll bring the roasted cauliflower mix I wanted you to taste.
Good. Also call me after work tomorrow, I want to ask about the portal message.
I’ll call after 6. Save me the small pan and I’ll finish the masala when I get there.
Beta, you still at the laptop? I kept dal for tomorrow. Don't sit twisted on the sofa again.
I moved to the table and put the warm pack on. Just finishing the review notes list so I can stop.
Good. Eat something simple and lie down before it becomes midnight.
Doing rice and yogurt now. Phone face down after I send Priya the last question.
When you come Sunday, bring your spreadsheet. I want to see how you track the bank transfers with the card bills.
I can show you. The cards pull the statement amounts on the 12th and 18th, so I just leave checking padded before those dates.
Good. Also keep the separate bank account for surprises. Do not use it for furniture shopping.
I know. The house folder is only screenshots right now anyway. West Chester numbers still make me close the tab.
Still want to do the Chester Valley stretch before coffee? It should be dry by 10.
Yes, but let's keep it to the shaded part. My legs still remember badminton from Friday.
Deal. I'll bring an extra fleece. You always look less wound up after that trail.
Exactly why I don't want to skip it. Coffee after, no spreadsheet talk.
Still good for coffee at 5:30 or did CPA take over?
Coffee yes. I just need 20 minutes first to sort the workbook categories; Sunday brain won't let me skip it.
Fine, but no opening your laptop at the cafe.
Deal. I'm at 4,180 projected if I don't add another dinner out, so cafe only.
For lunch today I made extra dal. Should I pack one small container for your place?
Yes please, just one. My freezer is already full from last Sunday.
Bring your spare fob too. Papa wants to check why the plastic cover cracked.
I only have the one spare, so I will put it in my bag now.
Mom wants to know if you're coming before 1 or after. Also are you bringing the green dip thing?
After 1. My legs are still cooked from yesterday's courts. I'll bring the dip.
Dad put the game on already and is pretending he just happened to find it.
Tell him I said save the second half. Megan might stop by later if her shift ends on time.
Beta, your W-2 from Hartwell came in the mail. Should I open and scan?
Yes please. There should be only one this year, same as last.
Only one envelope from a payer. Good. The library hours don't generate a tax form, correct?
Right, nothing from them. Just the firm.
Did you ever make dinner or did the laptop keep you hostage?
Green curry is on the way. I opened the fridge, stared at the containers, and closed it again.
Honestly fair. Put on something nice and eat it from a real bowl.
Already have Anoushka Shankar playing while I clear the counter.
ok the Kyoto carousel I sent you, did it come through? it was that account with the indie folk girl singing over the temple b-roll
how did the 6am thing go this week. still holding?
held 3 of 4 mornings. moved Wednesday to lunch bc a staffer needed me to walk through a workpaper reroll
got it, saved. the song was Adrianne Lenker right? the algorithm has been feeding me her stuff for weeks
you literally cannot keep giving the lunch slot away lol
lol you and your fingerpicked sad girl playlists. also my LinkedIn just lit up with someone from your office? did you accept?
i know i know. it was her first time tying out the lease schedule and she was about to redo it from scratch. 20 min vs her losing the afternoon
yeah accepted on LinkedIn. but I am NOT looking at any of that on the bird app, every time I open it I lose 40 minutes and gain a headache
yo are you alive or still chained to a spreadsheet
rebuilding the Sage Intacct tie-out from scratch because the GL export dropped the dimension columns again. on like row 4200
lol just export to csv and pivot it like a normal person

yes mom, Philadelphia. and dad's is Pune
ok ok. also Saturday i am making your favorite. you were so small when we brought you home from Jefferson, now you are 34 almost
lol mom please. yes i'll be there saturday before the 14th thing
throat is killing me, day 3 now 😩
do the ajwain steam tonight + warm saltwater gargle morning and night. turmeric milk before bed
ok. if it's not gone by friday i'll call dr ramirez. you still bringing the chicken sunday?
yes, doing it in avocado oil this time with the quinoa pilaf

Neither yet. The EOB hasn't fully processed — there's a contractual adjustment Quest is supposed to apply. Don't pay until I match line by line. Can you scan both pages and the remittance code?
Scanned. Also Mr. Iyer's daughter passed CPA in two sittings. He asked when yours is.
FAR in May, REG in August. I'll get there. Send the scans — I'll reconcile tonight after I finish my review block.
Beta, I forwarded the mortgage article. Rates may not stay low. Keep your down payment column strong.
I saw it. I am not touching that column, even with the yen folder tempting me.
Good. Also plan for your next test fee before adding anything extra.
Already mapped: house, Prometric/NASBA, then the folder with the temple photos.
The leasing office email you showed me asks for updated insurance proof. Did they need my signature anywhere?
No, it is just my portal. I uploaded the PDF and paid the $18 fee from checking.
Good. Keep the receipt with March papers. Also check if they added any extra parking charge.
Only my spot shows up. I saved the receipt in the apartment folder.
Still on for Saturday at your place? I can grab limes after shift.
Yes. I’m testing the quinoa dosa batter tonight, so you may be the first honest vote.
Deal. Do you need me to bring anything besides limes?
Maybe cilantro. I’m keeping Sunday morning open because I promised Mom I’d help with her batch too.
Beta, when you come this weekend, please check the box from the Exton basement. Your father's handwriting is on some papers and I cannot read the dates.
Sure. Is it the one with my Penn State folder or the one with Rohan's report cards?
Both mixed together, of course. I also kept the house phone bill from that year, don't laugh.
I won't laugh until Rohan sees it and starts blaming me for the dial-up noises.
Can I run the partner-meeting plan by you? My brain keeps rearranging the same five bullets.
Send the five bullets. Then shoes on and around the block once. No editing while walking.
Sent. Also my left side is doing the laptop thing again, so the walk is probably smart.
I marked only two wording changes. After the walk, make dinner with music, not another spreadsheet.

parking lot this year, lawn got destroyed last time. tell them park behind the gurdwara lot, the main one fills by 11
got it. are you running the kids' table again or just on the door?
door + the wristband table. anita put me on the sign-in sheet, i'll just hand them wristbands when they roll up

Yes appa, every other Friday. $2,400 net this one, the usual.
Good. Two of those plus the small one is $5,200 a month landing. Healthy. The 401k line went up - you bumped the percent?
Yeah after the firm match update. Match is still solid. Talk Sunday, ok? I'm back on the lease workpaper.

yes. same as last time, I'm walking with you and skipping the megaphone people
ha. you literally have not posted about any of this anywhere have you

Yep. No need to make a whole internet announcement out of a bad evening.
Exactly. I just need two sane voices and then sleep.

butter chicken + quinoa pilaf. picked up the cauliflower at wegmans already

send it, i'll call them monday

Yes. I had a $412 tire quote this morning and it was annoying, but I could handle it there instead of touching cards.
You still downtown? Dad asked if you picked up the flyer from the courthouse table.
Got it. I stopped at the ramen place first, then the table with the June lineup.
Want me to meet you by the garage or are you walking back with Megan?
Megan is walking with me. I am not doing that back corner alone after dinner.

scan both please, color, full page. I'll drop them into TurboTax tonight with the rest

Take a photo and send it. I will upload it with the bill question when I log in for you.
Did you take the extra spinach from here?

ya put it on the calendar same as the exam stuff. otherwise it gets eaten

can you send. i refuse to be the person who skips half a ballot again

you still up? saw your slack status earlier said 'in workpaper review until ?'

sarada. close the laptop. seriously. is dr. cohen renewing your refill thing the 26th? bc you cannot run on no sleep
i know. saturday hike still on? need to be a person for like 4 hours.

it bugs me because the same outcome for two different families isn't the same story. who got stopped, who got warned, who got charged. she just sees the ending

One more pass. The workpaper tied out but two footnotes don't reconcile to the trial balance and I want it clean before partner review.

Your arm is okay today? You said yesterday it might be sore.
A little sore, nothing major. The nurse said that can happen for a day.

Ask him, but use the Main Line Health page I sent too. I do not want Appa relying on a cropped screenshot.

Yes, the one with the university seal. Same scan I used for Dad's commerce degree letter.

Good idea. Keep that paper with the SSA folder so we have everything in one place.

ok ok. also the West Chester chaat festival you sent me on Instagram, when is that? I want to come
March 28, I'll DM you the IG post again. Megan and I are going around noon

ha. honestly the shape in my head is small - immigrant-owned businesses around exton, the families that get scared off by big firm pricing
you'd be so good at that. but finish the four sections first pls
thats the plan. license then a few more years carrying engagements as senior manager, then maybe

good. group chat is not where that conversation works. I'll call her Sunday after lunch
what do you even say. she's not going to suddenly care about fair treatment for immigrants because of a text
I just tell her what I actually voted for and why. health care, the schools, immigration, climate. real talk, not a thread
Mom found the old photo of you in front of India Gate. The giant sunglasses era was rough.
That Delhi heat deserved giant sunglasses. Send it but don't put it in the family thread.
Deal. Also your YouTube is all Shinkansen snack videos and Italian train chaos again?
The algorithm knows my weak spots. I am only saving routes, not booking anything until after the next CPA payment.
I found the old PECO envelope from Whitford Road. It has my name and your mother's name, so keep it with the school forms.
Thanks. Was Rohan's folder in the same box or did Mom move it to the closet?
Same box. Ask him to check the network drive when he comes from King of Prussia; he made a scan folder last time.
I'll ask him tonight. If he named it something ridiculous, I'm blaming you both.
Do you still have that Kyoto spreadsheet? I need something nice to stare at between review notes.
Yes, sending. Also breathe before you answer your aunt's 'timeline' text.
Too late, I already screenshotted it to you instead of replying.

Straight to Mom’s. Dad said he’ll come over after he checks that bill folder.
Ok. I’m bringing the lighter pav bhaji version, so don’t complain before tasting it.
No promises. I’ll bring the onions if you handle the actual pan work.
Mom asked if you're coming Sunday or buried in tax files again.
Coming. I may detour through Marsh Creek first if I can get one more return out tonight.
You and your detours. Bring the green chutney container back if you remember.
Putting it by my sneakers now. If I don't move around before lunch, I'll be useless by 3.
Before Sunday lunch, can you print the insurance page? Also your mother wants the paper with the music times.
Yes. I can print it at the library, get coffee, and bring the music schedule from the Market St rack.
Do not park far if you are carrying papers.
I will use the street spots by the library if one opens. In daylight it is fine.

ugh again? 03/14/1992, Philadelphia PA

hike sunday morning? trying to drag you outside before you fuse with your laptop

i can drop off ginger-turmeric soup tonight, already cooking
